basic_info.description: Residence #105 features an expansive,~261 sq.ft. terrace that steps directly out to a stunning garden courtyard. Warm afternoon sun streams through this one-bed, one-bath floor-to-ceiling windows. This residence is offered with our Pre-Opening Pricing for a limited time. Designed by Hart Howerton & Edmonds + Lee with a gracious floor plan, kitchen with Arclinea cabinetry & integrated Miele appliances, white oak flooring, spa-style baths featuring Carrara marble countertops, 9'-10'5 ceilings in living/bedroom & MERV 13 filters. Building amenities include a rooftop terrace, fitness studio, & indoor-outdoor lounge. Residents will have access to unprecedented amenities, including ~10,000 SF Island Club with fitness studio & programming, outdoor pool, spa & fireplace, private dining room; staffed front desks; 24/7 roving security; resident app with services; shuttle to/from the ferry. Parking is offered separately at $115K. Images/view are representative.
